I ordered this as a replacement in 2019, for the stock fridge handle that cracked and broke. The build quality and fit and finish appeared to be a good match for the original, but was a couple mm more shallow, so didn't line up with the original freezer handle. Swapping that out as well was fine, despite there having been no issue with the original freezer handle.

Now, in 2022, the replacement handle has cracker again, and is on it's last legs. The replacement doesn't seem as sturdy as the original, only lasting ~3 years. That said, I am happy to purchase the same, as these are pretty minor gripes, hence the 4 stars.
